bio: The Edge Ideas that Compound The Edge is a weekly letter from George Serafeim — insights from the classroom, boardroom, gym mat, and beyond. Ideas that compound, tested in work and life.

Williams Professor of Business Administration Charles M. Williams Professor of Business Administration Read more George Serafeim is the Charles M. Williams Professor of Business Administration at Harvard Business School. His work examines how organizations drive performance and create value in periods of technological, environmental, social, and institutional change.
